sentences.text: Florence Glenda Chapman -LRB- née Ballard ; June 30 , 1943 -- February 22 , 1976 -RRB- was an American vocalist .	American	United States	vocalist	vocalist	1976	1976 in music
She was one of the founding members of the popular Motown vocal female group the Supremes .	Motown	Motown	the Supremes	the Supremes
Ballard sang on 16 top forty singles with the group , including ten number-one hits .	top forty	Billboard Hot 100

After being removed from the Supremes in 1967 , Ballard tried an unsuccessful solo career with ABC Records before she was dropped from the label at the end of the decade .	ABC	ABC Records	the Supremes	the Supremes	ABC Records	ABC Records
Ballard struggled with alcoholism , depression , and poverty for three years .	alcoholism	alcoholism	depression	Depression (mood)	poverty	poverty
She was making an attempt for a musical comeback when she died of a heart attack in February 1976 at the age of 32 .	heart attack	Myocardial infarction	1976	1976 in music
Ballard 's death was considered by one critic as `` one of rock 's greatest tragedies '' .	rock	rock and roll
Ballard was posthumously inducted to the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame as a member of the Supremes in 1988 .	the Supremes	the Supremes	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame
